identity.summary: Principals, Agent IDs and execution bindings, credential custody (GitHub App keys, secret stores and providers) and token minting, authorization, owner gate, revocation and audit.

soul.summary: Soul definition and packages, population and lifecycle, workspace and environment, harness provisioning, configuration generation, launch and resume.

harness.summary: Harness knowledge: which harness is running and how each one shapes hooks and configuration. Describes; never provisions or launches.

comms.summary: Client side of agent-comms in this runtime: broker client, relay, wake listener and dispatch, and task turns. Authenticates through identity; never decides whether a soul exists.

org.summary: Organization and SOP resolution from pinned external sources (agent-org, agent-sop); exposes a validated view, never authority.

shared.summary: Non-privileged leaf utilities with no ownership of their own: configuration, shell path, logging. Nothing here reads a credential or secret.

host.summary: Long-running process hosts that compose modules: the daemon, its supervisor and wake plane, MCP servers, the interaction plane, the harness hook runner and adapters.

cli.summary: The agent-bot command facade and install/readiness tooling that compose modules for one command.

notes.acp-registry.mjs: Spawn rows select and launch harnesses, so soul owns them (ADR-0276, ADR-0322). Descriptive columns are candidates for agent-harness descriptors.
notes.agent-approvals.mjs: The `agent-bot approvals` command entry; cli, like skill.mjs. Approval decisions still go through the daemon and owner-gate.
notes.agent-backfill.mjs: Repairs census provenance by writing population rows (upsertSoul); soul lifecycle, loaded by agent-population's backfill command, which passes in the census functions it uses so this module does not import agent-population.mjs (#1386).
notes.agent-hook.mjs: Process entry point every harness hook config calls; composes binding, confinement and the unbound-bot identity check.
notes.approval-action.mjs: Names a waiting proposal's soul from the population for the owner's prompt; soul, shared by the daemon host and the approvals command.
notes.canonical-json.mjs: The canonical byte form behind soul revisions and genesis IDs; shared so identity can derive IDs without importing soul. soul-package re-exports it.
notes.cli/command-registry.mjs: The agent-bot command registry (#1394, HQ plan Stage 0 row 9): cli/dispatch.mjs registers every command once, with its visibility, module or run function and subcommand routes; the parser accepts the registered names and the dispatcher resolves each invocation here. Cli, because only the dispatcher and the parser use it. It is the in-place form of HQ plugin registration (plan section 4.2, ctx.commands.register).
notes.cli/identity.mjs: `agent-bot identity`: composes identity with soul (a local `spawn --package` hashes the package) and the census (`finalize`). It runs identity's record operations through identityOp and asks the daemon for a spawn through daemon-client.mjs (#645, F13); agent-identity.mjs keeps the library and the git hooks' entry (current, show, record).
notes.cli/mint-output.mjs: The documented stdout of `agent-bot mint-token` (plain token or the `--json` object). The module map assigns this formatter to identity together with cli/mint-token.mjs, the command it formats for (#645, F13 step 2).
notes.cli/mint-token.mjs: `agent-bot mint-token`: identity's own command line. It sits in cli/ because dispatch runs it as its own process; the module map assigns it to identity, as the owner chose for the thin wrappers (#645, F13 step 2). Every import is identity's.
notes.cli/soul-env-transfer.mjs: The `soul env export|import` process entry: composes the soul module's life archive with the host interaction store (#583), which soul may not import.
notes.comms-membership.mjs: Joins and leaves agent-comms as a launched soul; split from the daemon host so soul lifecycle commands need not import it.
notes.daemon-client.mjs: Identity's daemon contract (#645, F5, owner decision D3): the daemon state file, its loopback base URL, the health probe and the authenticated client every module uses to call the daemon. It stays identity-owned because the client reads the bearer token and signs binding proofs, which shared may not do (ADR-0645).
notes.identity-entry.mjs: Identity's record entry (#645, F6; owner decision D4, F6 answers Q1 and Q2): other modules run it as a child process through identityOp in daemon-client.mjs instead of importing agent-identity.mjs. JSON in on stdin, JSON out on stdout; no daemon route.
notes.daemon-log.mjs: Logging helper used by several modules; shared, not host.
notes.daemon-status.mjs: Daemon status for callers outside the host; in comms because it folds in agent-comms status (readCommsStatus), which identity may not import.
notes.detect-harness.mjs: Reads its harness vocabulary from organization-profile-schema (PROFILE_HARNESSES); one of the duplicated harness key tables.
notes.file-lock.mjs: Directory locks with stale-lock reclaim (withLock, reclaimStaleLock), moved from agent-identity.mjs so soul, comms and host guard their state files without importing identity (#645, decision D1). Node built-ins only; reads no credential.
notes.identity-app-souls.mjs: The census and soul.json declarations identity-apps.mjs needs, passed in as its `souls` port by cli/identity-apps.mjs and the daemon (#645); identity never reads them itself.
notes.identity-cli.mjs: Identity's published entry for cli (#645, F13 steps 3 and 4; the owner's revised Q-F13-3 answer and the F8 answer): in-process re-exports for readiness, doctor, bootstrap, sync-hooks and the owner, principal, identity and App commands, so readiness keeps its injectable probes and presence prompts keep the terminal. Listed as a contract importable by cli only.
notes.identity-format.mjs: Identity's format contract (#645, F1 and F4, owner decision D2): the Agent ID, principal and transport formats, the audit receipt writer, the git config key names, the owner-credential refusal, tool-call display risk, the git hook names and the credential item names, so soul, host, cli and comms need no identity internals for them. It imports only node built-ins and the shared state-paths.mjs, so it can be kept byte-identical with identity's copy after the extraction (ADR-0645, answer 2).
notes.identity-host.mjs: Identity's one entry for host (#645, F9; owner decision D5, F9 answers Q1 and Q2 (a)): it re-exports every identity function host uses in-process, so host imports no other identity file. It also exports identity's daemon route handler, createIdentityRoutes (F9 step 2), and identity's half of /v0/spawn, spawnChildIdentity (F9 step 4); /v0/register is soul's route since F9 step 3.
notes.identity-routes.mjs: Identity's daemon routes (#645, F9 step 2): bind, binding, binding App, credential, inbox take, grants and keyd grant, plus identity's half of spawn (spawnChildIdentity, F9 step 4: mint and bind; the daemon keeps the route and runs the spawn hook). agent-daemon.mjs keeps the server and its auth and passes the binding-proof checks in, with the host and soul steps the routes use, as ports; host reaches it through identity-host.mjs. createIdentityRoutes returns the routes with their auth classes and the handler, for the daemon's route registry (#1392).
notes.identity-soul.mjs: Identity's published entry for soul and comms (#645; owner decisions of 2026-10-11): in-process re-exports of what must stay in the caller's process (binding and bot-identity reads, vouch key paths, co-author rules, session grants), credential custody (F7) and the owner gate, statements and presence (F8). Listed as a contract importable by soul and comms.
notes.metrics.mjs: Host: records harness sessions from the session-start hook and is read by the daemon; the `metrics` command in cli composes it. Keeps the composition roots acyclic (cli may import host, never the reverse).
notes.organization-profile-schema.mjs: The profile schema, validator and runtime-config projection. config.json embeds a validated profile snapshot, so config (shared) and detect-harness (harness) read it here; organization-profile (org) keeps external acquisition and re-exports this.
notes.route-registry.mjs: The daemon's route registry (#1392, HQ plan Stage 0 row 8): every route source registers its routes with an auth class per route, and the daemon checks the bearer and refuses a soul binding on owner routes from those classes before dispatching through it. Host, because only the daemon imports it: identity and soul return their declarations from createIdentityRoutes and createSoulRoutes and import nothing from here. It is the in-place form of HQ plugin registration (plan section 4.2).
notes.runtime-catalog.mjs: Reviewed pin catalogue bundled with each release (ADR-0322 decision 8); stays in soul, never sourced from harness-docs.
notes.secret-store.mjs: Identity: secret stores and providers (secret.mjs, secret-store.mjs, secret-providers/*) retrieve credentials, so they are identity-owned rather than shared, and harness, org and shared cannot reach them.
notes.session-bind.mjs: The `session bind` command (#1170): a cli composition root that validates or establishes the worktree's live session binding through identity's contracts and the daemon client.
notes.setup-worktree.mjs: Places a checkout in the soul work area and asks identity for its attribution.
notes.sop.mjs: The `agent-bot sop` command and the SOP policy activation state. Per-soul SOP selection is soul policy (ADR-0332), in sop-selection.mjs; its pinned-source resolution is the org resolver, sop-resolver.mjs (#1388). sop.mjs re-exports the names it exported before.
notes.sop-resolver.mjs: The SOP org resolver (#1388, HQ plan §2.4 C3): config and org.json parsing, bounded git reads at exact commits, the document cache, workflows, and the persona and last-good records. Imports only shared. sandbox.mjs reads the persona names here, not from sop.mjs, whose persona command loads the sandbox; that pair closed C3.
notes.sop-selection.mjs: The soul's SOP selection (#1388, HQ plan §2.4 C3): which agent-sop.toml a soul's session selects, and the trust store for foreign selections. soul-profile.mjs imports it rather than sop.mjs, whose persona command loads the sandbox; the sandbox reaches soul-revisions.mjs, which imports soul-profile.mjs, and that loop closed C3.
notes.soul-builder.mjs: Generation stays in soul; its per-harness file tables are harness knowledge to be read from agent-harness.
notes.soul-credential-migration.mjs: `identity migrate-credentials`: copies keys through identity's stores, then records the store in soul.json as a revision edit, which is soul state (#645).
notes.soul-credentials.mjs: Named for souls but holds GitHub App credential custody (resolveAppCredential); identity-owned. Rename only with a compatibility plan. It learns which soul declares an App through soul's read-only contract soul-app-declarations.mjs (#645).
notes.soul-genesis.mjs: Derives a soul's Agent ID from its genesis (revision, parent, nonce); identity owns ID minting, so it is identity even though the revision it hashes comes from soul.
notes.soul-revision-store.mjs: The RevisionStore port (#1388, HQ plan §2.4 C3): the read side of a soul's revision journal (where it is, its revision records, a stored revision's package). skill-manifest.mjs reads revisions here rather than from soul-revisions.mjs, which imports skill-manifest.mjs for skill diffs; that pair closed C3. soul-revisions.mjs keeps the writers and re-exports the readers. HQ storage can back the port later.
notes.soul-routes.mjs: Soul's daemon routes (#645, F9 step 3; owner decision D6): POST /v0/register, which records a soul's space and worktree in the census. agent-daemon.mjs keeps the server and the bearer check; createSoulRoutes returns the route, its auth class and the handler for the daemon's route registry (#1392).
notes.soul-tool-homes.mjs: Tool-home routes are generated per soul (ADR-0583). Routability facts are harness knowledge.
notes.tool-registry.mjs: The MCP tool registry (#1394, HQ plan Stage 0 row 9): agent-mcp.mjs and daemon-mcp.mjs register each tool once, with its schema, class, handler and listing conditions, and read tools/list, discovery and calls from it. Host, because only the two MCP servers import it. It is the in-place form of HQ plugin registration (plan section 4.2, ctx.tools.register).
notes.wake-plane.mjs: Daemon side of the agent-comms wake plane (agent-comms ADR-0008): launches souls on wakes, so it composes soul and comms.
notes.windows-account-custody.mjs: Shared (owner decision on #645, F11, 2026-10-11): Windows SID and ACL checks used by identity (vouch.mjs) and comms (comms-windows.mjs). It reads ownership and attributes, never a file's contents, so it holds no credential.
notes.cold-wake-lock.mjs: Shared synchronous settings lock/path mechanism, with ephemeral lock-held tokens; reads no settings or credentials.
notes.wake-webhook-store.mjs: Internal comms-owned webhook storage. Helpers require the active shared cold-wake lock before the per-soul webhook lock; existing public access stays in wake-webhook.mjs.
notes.identity/server-client.mjs: Identity: opt-in agent-bot server mode (docs/server-mode.md) — device enrollment, DPoP-bound access tokens and server-minted installation tokens; identity/mint-token.mjs delegates to it when AGENT_BOT_SERVER is set.
notes.identity/action-ledger.mjs: Identity: the durable action ledger for credential requests to the identity service (prepared, submitted, succeeded, rejected, unknown); an unknown outcome is reconciled by lookup, never re-sent blind (0.4 T06, #1184).
notes.identity/provider-key.mjs: Identity: the pilot provider key (owner decision D2), fetched from the identity service at daemon start, held in memory only, dropped on device revocation, receipted as provider-key-exception (#1184).
notes.identity/inference-proxy.mjs: Identity: the loopback inference proxy (#1190); swaps a short-lived proxy token for the pilot provider key the daemon holds, so the key never reaches a member process.
notes.soul-approvals.mjs: The approvals port every owner-only soul command asks before a change (#1384, HQ plan §2.4 C1 remedy 3). Backed today by assertOwnerAction with detect off, the gate cold-wake-settings.mjs used to hold; HQ approval records back it later. Kept apart from the settings modules so the census never reaches identity through the gate.
notes.soul-mode-store.mjs: The soul mode settings file and its readers, with no gate (#1384). The census reads modes here rather than from soul-mode.mjs, whose command imports the owner approvals port; that import tied the census into identity's credential cycle (C1). soul-mode.mjs re-exports these names.
notes.soul-model-store.mjs: The soul model settings file and its readers, with no gate (#1384). The census reads models here rather than from soul-model.mjs, whose command imports the owner approvals port (C1). soul-model.mjs re-exports the names it exported before.
notes.agent-space-root.mjs: The spaces root and a soul's default path under it (#1386), below agent-space.mjs and soul-space-path.mjs so agent-space.mjs and soul-memory.mjs share no import cycle (HQ plan §2.4, C2). agent-space.mjs re-exports it.
notes.soul-space-path.mjs: Where a soul's Agent Space is: the census spacePath, else the spaces root (#1386). Below agent-space.mjs's command line and soul-memory.mjs, which re-exports it (HQ plan §2.4, C2); the first piece of the life-store port.
notes.soul-tool-home-inspect.mjs: Read-only inspection of a soul's tool homes (#1386), below soul-env.mjs and soul-env-migrate.mjs so the descriptor and the migration share no import cycle (HQ plan §2.4, C4). soul-env-migrate.mjs re-exports inspectToolHomes.
notes.identity/app-jwt.mjs: Identity: the legacy-local-custody check and the App JWT (#1386), below mint-token.mjs and soul-credentials.mjs so they share no import cycle. mint-token.mjs re-exports both.
notes.identity/app-records.mjs: Identity: App slugs, App-scoped store targets, public App metadata and the managed App credential read from given stores (#1386), below identity-app-store.mjs and soul-credentials.mjs so they share no import cycle. identity-app-store.mjs re-exports its old names and keeps the stores default.
notes.daemon-state.mjs: The daemon's lifecycle as other processes see it: start detached, stop through the state record, the wrong-account warning (#1386). The daemon state module of HQ plan §2.4 (C5): agent-web.mjs and daemon-supervisor.mjs import it instead of agent-daemon.mjs, which re-exports it.

identity-host.mjs.reason: Owner decision D5 and F9 answer Q1 (a) on #645 (2026-10-11): host loads identity through one published entry, listed with its exact exports so widening it is a reviewed map change.

daemon-client.mjs.reason: Owner answers on #645 (answer 2, 2026-10-09; decision D3, 2026-10-11): daemon-client.mjs is the one sanctioned way soul, host, cli and comms reach the daemon, and daemon.json keeps its format. Listed with its exact exports so widening it is a reviewed map change.

identity-cli.mjs.reason: Owner answer on #645 (F13 Q3, revised 2026-10-11): cli's readiness, doctor, bootstrap and sync-hooks code reaches identity through one published entry, in-process, instead of a doctor-checks child process, so readiness keeps its injectable probes. The F8 answer (2026-10-11) adds the owner-gate, statement and presence functions and the principal, identity and App command functions, in-process. Listed with its exact exports so widening it is a reviewed map change.

identity-soul.mjs.reason: Owner answers on #645 (2026-10-11, option (a) on all four): soul and comms reach identity in-process through one published entry, as host does through identity-host.mjs and cli through identity-cli.mjs; F7 credential custody and the F8 owner-gate functions are listed here too. Listed with its exact exports so widening it is a reviewed map change.

identity-format.mjs.reason: Owner answers on #645 (answer 2, 2026-10-09; decision D2, 2026-10-11): pure identity format helpers and the shared audit receipt writer, which appends the same audit.jsonl lines in-process so receipts work while the daemon is down. Later F1 slices add the remaining format helpers here. The enforcement-profile and legacy-local-custody helpers (#1184) live here because every receipt names the profile in force.

soul-app-declarations.mjs.reason: Owner decision on #645 (2026-10-09): identity's in-process minters (git credential helper, signed-commit) learn which soul declares an App, and which census souls use it, through this read-only soul contract rather than soul internals, so minting works without the daemon.

identity-presence.mjs.reason: Reviewed pure p1 verification entry for broker owner-decision binding (#77); preserves existing agent-bot semantics without exposing custody or prompting.

targets.daemon: HQ core in agent-bot-daemon, outside every Soul: the host, the HQ CLI and owner commands, the org resolver, and HQ identity authority (enrollment, the identity-service link, the signer, credential references, grants, approvals; PDR-0027).
targets.daemon/sdk: @agent-bot/sdk, vendored by digest: shared and harness code and the wire/ codecs, used on both sides (plan §2.1, §2.3).
targets.identity: agent-bot-identity's plugin and Soul-side tools: the agent-bot CLI members run, git and harness hooks, fail-closed gh, and the member surfaces it registers (PDR-0027).
targets.identity service: The identity service (true-line/agent-bot): key custody, App management and minting. Code bound here leaves the host (plan §2.1, §3.2).
targets.comms: agent-comms: broker mode in HQ, client mode in the Soul (plan §2.1).
targets.soul-runtime/core: Soul runtime core, pure and used on both sides (plan §2.1, §6).
targets.soul-runtime/hq: Soul runtime HQ side: validation, render, admission, launch, transfer. Package and render code goes to soul-package (plan §2.1).
targets.soul-runtime/entry-point: Soul runtime entry point: front door, members, recovery, in agent-bot-souls (plan §2.1).
targets.deprecated: Removed, not carried into any repository (plan §8.2).

domains.HQ: Runs in HQ, the trusted local host service.
domains.Soul: Runs inside the Soul, untrusted for authority.
domains.HQ + Soul: A shared library or core used on both sides.
domains.owner client: Runs as the owner's client of HQ.

cli/command-registry.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. The agent-bot command registry; only cli/dispatch.mjs imports it, so it goes where the dispatcher goes. The SDK's ctx.commands replaces it for the commands members run (plan section 4.2).

cli/machine.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. An owner command: HQ CLI.

cloud.mjs.note: Machine lifecycle for a short-lived host: starts the daemon and enrolls or unenrolls the device, like bootstrap.mjs and server enroll/logout.

identity/action-ledger.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. The action ledger is HQ's authoritative store (plan §3.2).

identity/agent-sessions.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. Session records are authority state (ADR-1257), HQ identity authority under PDR-0027.

identity/events.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. `agent-bot events`, run by members and their hooks: a member surface (PDR-0027).

identity/identity-apps.mjs.note: Appendix A: identity (owner command) → identity service. App onboarding moves to the identity service.

identity/inference-proxy.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. HQ's loopback inference proxy for the pilot provider key (D2, #1190).

identity/provider-key.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. The pilot provider key is held in HQ memory only (agent-bot-daemon D2).

identity/redaction-patterns.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. Redaction shapes for receipts, the ledger, logs and diagnostics on both sides.

identity/relay-events.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. Live-session events a member reads (#39): a member surface (PDR-0027).

identity/server-client.mjs.note: Appendix A: daemon (link) + identity (enrollment). Both are HQ core under PDR-0027.

identity/server-notices.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. The identity-service client for notices/take, over HQ's link (plan §4.8); custody-then-ack in the broker is §9 row 11.

machine-client.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. HQ's client of the agent-bot-machine admin sandbox (agent-bot-daemon D4).

machine-members.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. Reads the member accounts plans agent-bot-machine saves and recomputes their digest for the approve-members proposal (#1401); beside machine-client.mjs, HQ's client of agent-machine.

server-status.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. Server-mode status and doctor shapes for HQ's surfaces.

skill-for-map.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. A static lookup table, shared.

sop.mjs.note: Appendix A: daemon (org resolver) + soul-runtime/core (selection). §9 row 5 moved the selection to sop-selection.mjs and the resolver to sop-resolver.mjs; the rest goes with the org resolver.

start.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. `agent-bot start` checks a session in from the Soul: an agent-bot CLI command members run, like session-bind.mjs.

tool-registry.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. The MCP tool registry agent-mcp.mjs and daemon-mcp.mjs register their member tools in; the SDK's ctx.tools replaces it when they register through hq-plugin-contract (plan section 4.2).

workflow.mjs.note: Not in Appendix A. A cli composition root, mapped like its owner-side peers.
